description: Wraps the review-remediation-record (001) and lifecycle-orchestration (002) capability text in versioned MERIDIAN:BEGIN/END markers, so a future upgrade can tell a cosmetic merge conflict from a real gap instead of relying only on file-hash comparison. Detection and verification code are unchanged in this migration; see migrations/CAPABILITY_MARKERS.md.
verification: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md wrap their Review-remediation workflow section in <!-- MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=review-remediation-record v1 --> / <!-- MERIDIAN:END -->
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md wrap their Autonomous lifecycle orchestration section in <!-- MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=lifecycle-orchestration v1 --> / <!-- MERIDIAN:END -->
docs/REVIEW_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md and docs/LIFECYCLE_ORCHESTRATION.md wrap their entire body (after the H1 title) in the matching marker pair
detect_capabilities() behavior and its existing tests are unaffected: the wrapped text still contains the literal Address review / Run lifecycle phrases
